item.text: I found this is a standalone utility module rather than a test suite; I’m grabbing line numbers now so the bug references are precise.

`test/orders.js` exports simple order helpers:

- `calcTotal(items)`: sums `price * qty` for each item.
- `applyDiscount(total, code)`: applies `SAVE10` or `SAVE20`.
- `averageItemPrice(items)`: divides the total by item count.
- `formatOrder(order)`: formats line items and a discounted total string.

Bugs I see:

- [orders.js](/C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-cjlPAQ/test/orders.js:5): `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length`, so it reads one past the end. `items[items.length]` is `undefined`, causing `Cannot read properties of undefined`.
- [orders.js](/C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-cjlPAQ/test/orders.js:20): `averageItemPrice([])` divides by zero and returns `NaN` or `Infinity` depending on upstream behavior. It should probably handle empty arrays explicitly.
